title: Day after tehrvi, ‘dead’ Ghaziabad man returns home
summary: A Ghaziabad family mourned and cremated Girdhar Bisht, believing him murdered, only for him to return home 13 days later. Bisht, who had been in jail and then went missing, claims he was meditating in Punjab.
